name: Blue Plus Hotel
description: Located in the heart of Taksim Square, Blue Plus Hotel offers an ideal stay for both leisure and business travelers. The property is within walking distance of Istiklal Street, one of Istanbul’s most famous shopping and entertainment avenues, filled with restaurants, cafés, bars, and local boutiques. Taksim Metro Station, bus stops, airport shuttle services (Havaist), and the historic Taksim Funicular provide easy access to all parts of the city. Guests can easily visit Galata Tower, Galataport, Dolmabahçe Palace, Karaköy, Galata Bridge, Eminönü, Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, Bosphorus cruises, and many other iconic attractions. The hotel is also surrounded by supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, shopping centers, and a wide variety of dining options. With its central location, comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, and friendly staff, Blue Plus Hotel is the perfect choice for discovering Istanbul.
